crossRefs.note: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me…
Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Yahweh, the God of…
Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” Yahweh said, “They will deliver…
The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place; for the Syrians are coming…
The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not…
Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night, and surrounded the city.
He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here…
If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

translations.web: Yahweh gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.
translations.bsb: And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.
translations.kjv: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
translations.asv: And Jehovah gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it: then thou showedst me their doings.
